purpose: Generate sewing, textile, embroidery, knitting, crochet, weaving, pressing, and maintenance equipment as named Blender proxy assets.

shape_type_legend.cylinder: round rod, spool, pin, peg, dial, disk
shape_type_legend.cone: needle tip, awl point, tapered nozzle
shape_type_legend.bezier_curve: thread, cord, cable, flexible tape, wire
shape_type_legend.flat_spline_plate: rulers and drafting curves with curved outlines
shape_type_legend.frame: loom, hoop, embroidery frame, machine shell supports
shape_type_legend.soft_form: ham, sleeve roll, padded mitt, pincushion
